name: Platform split hero with quote and logo row
purpose: Open the main platform page with the product promise, a customer quote as proof and the demo CTA, then a customer-logo strip.
description: Split hero (/lms, pulled up -1rem): left column has a serif 3.8rem H1 (2.5rem <=479), grey intro, italic quote with 40px avatar, name and role + linked company, and a primary CTA; right column is a 1440:1339 product visual. Below, a centred one-line lead and an 8-slot logo row (flex space-between, max 60rem, wrapping and centring <=991). Columns stack <=767.
